account_name.description: The name on the account, as the bank holds it.

account_number.description: The full number as the vendor's letter prints it; spaces and hyphens are dropped. A Singapore account: 6 to 17 digits. Overseas: 4 to 34 letters and digits, or an IBAN, whose check digits are checked. Needed to prepare a change; left out when replacing a draft, the number saved before stays (unless the bank changes). Sealed on save, never logged or audited (SEC-11).

bank_country.description: The bank's country, ISO 3166 two-letter code.

bic.description: The bank's SWIFT/BIC code, 8 or 11 characters, whose country is the bank's.

callback_note.description: Who you called back, when, and on which number: one you knew before, never one from the letter (recommended evidence, FR-DOC-06).
examples: Called Jane Tan, Northwind finance, on 6123 4567 from our records, 27 Oct 2026 10:15

currency.description: The currency paid into the account: a change is for one currency, and keeps it.

kind.description: singapore: a Singapore bank (bank_country SG); overseas: a bank outside Singapore.
